title: A great way to taste the...
text: A great way to taste the local food. The places we were taken to taste had all different ambiance which gave us a true taste of the area. The tapas were delicious and so was the vermouth. Joanna our tour guide was wonderful and very accommodating.  Would highly recommend this tour.
author: Angela_L

title: Great Guide
text: Our guide Mel was great.  She made the whole experience pleasant.  Mel was very easy to talk to and very knowledgeable about the area and food.  We think the price of the tour was too much.  Mel made the experience better, but pricing needs to be reviewed by company.
author: adrianabY4056LY

title: Great way to experience Gracía and the food of Barcelona
text: Awesome food tour in the Gracía neighborhood, hitting a lot of unique and cool spots we wouldn’t otherwise think to go or get into because they were busy. Francesco was awesome! Felt like we were hanging out with an old friend.
author: Alex_M

title: Local Barcelona Tapas
text: Chaimae did an amazing job of taking us around to local Tapas spots. The food was delicious and plentiful.
author: M4303JGmikef

title: Local flavor at its best
text: Fafar was so friendly and informative about the neighborhood. I loved her "local color" stories of event and celebrations in the neighborhood. He husband joined us on the tour and that was equally as enjoyable. It was a great first "local taste" to Catalonian food. Perfect for our first day in Barcelona.
author: W7416YQjenniferd

title: a wonderful walking tour
text: Fafar was a wonderful guide!  We had a terrific time!
author: Sightsee14984620339

title: Lovely way to explore Gracia in the evening
text: My teenage daughter and I had a lovely evening tour with Fafar and her husband! The food was delicious, we loved getting to explore some local bars we'd walked by but hadn't tried, and the conversation with our guides was rich and meaningful. Two of my favorite parts of travel are food and people, and this tour more than fulfilled both!
author: boethe

title: Delightful evening of Catalan taste and culture!
text: Chaimae was such a delight. We were not expecting a private tour but it was wonderful to be shown around this gem of a neighborhood by such a thoughtful and talented guide.  The first stop was, unfortunately, a no-go for a small tapas tasting, so we moved on to the rest of our spots and Chaimae didn’t miss a beat, arranging for two tapas tastes at the next restaurant where the staff were more obliging. The vegetarian options selected were beautifully presented, freshly prepared, tasty and plentiful, and by the time we got to the last stop for dessert we could barely finish the extraordinary Cr
author: lbgans

title: Wonderful food tour!
text: We had such a great food tour! Chaimae was our excellent tour guide. We were introduced to so many neat places and tried so many new foods. The restaurants were welcoming and friendly. Our favorites were the la bomba and bottifara sausage. I highly recommend this tour!
author: angiek484

title: Exceptional experience
text:
Our guide had great local knowledge, within the experience we tried local cuisine in areas we had never visited before and also the history of the area and eating places made us even more appreciative of the tour.

We would recommend trying the experience without a doubt.
author: Tony_V
